version: puppet-v1 (Skeleton2D cutout bake, all 8 directions; overrides same-name v3 clips)
ground_depth_note: Phase 1d. Per frame: ground_depth_m = how far the anchor (card ground line) sits toward the camera from the physics body along the view axis; body_px / board_px = the body ground point / deck centre in master px from the anchor (y down); body_scale = bake perspective scale at the body. Sides: 0 / [0,0] / 1. The game moves the card toward the camera so body_px lands on the physics body.

atlas.note: same conventions as frames_v3.json. Never mirrored. Each frame names its atlas_file (sides / back group / front group). Web pack at scale_from_master=0.175 (park default ~176 px standing); pixel_size_m adjusted to keep 1.720 m world height.
